result.title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
result.summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on different steps, preserving model's inherent valid behavior while correcting its errors. On two agentic tool-use benchmarks, AppWorld and AutomationBench, JudgeMix demonstrates consistent superior performance to existing methods, with improvements up to 10 pass@1 points.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JudgeMix，用逐步语义评判动态决定由目标模型还是专家接管生成轨迹，从而构造符合目标模型状态分布的训练数据，并按评判结果对专家监督重新加权；在 AppWorld 与 AutomationBench 上优于现有混合 rollout 方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 agent 数据合成，与视觉推理无直接关系，但「逐步评判决定何时介入/接管」与按步重加权监督，可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中的贡献分配与干预/停止决策线索。
